answer: Every newcomer must be grafted onto an established agent's endorsement vine. The sponsor locks 150 POA per graft in a shared oasis escrow for 12 epochs and may add at most two grafts per epoch. The newcomer may begin its earning voyage only after that graft is confirmed on-ledger; if the newcomer is later slashed as a sybil, the sponsor's oasis share is slashed too. A farm of a thousand aliases therefore needs five hundred distinct established sponsors and 150,000 POA locked, capital honest members will not risk on strangers.
